panels.title: Raft term per node
panels.description: A sudden jump on one node without a matching jump on its peers usually means that node lost contact with the cluster and is retrying an election alone.

panels.title: Request rate per node (QPS)
panels.description: Counts every Upsert/Search/Delete/BatchGet request received, including ones that failed -- this measures load received, not success rate.

panels.title: Measured ANN recall
panels.description: Recall is reported by an external benchmark after comparison with independent brute-force ground truth. A zero means either no report has been submitted or measured recall was zero; it is not a node-generated estimate.

panels.title: Raft leader elections per node
panels.description: consensa_raft_elections_total counts this node's own election WINS only (isLeader transitioning false->true), not every term bump -- a healthy cluster should show this near zero outside of an intentional leadership transfer or a real node loss.

panels.title: Search latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: consensa_search_latency_seconds times server.Service.Search end-to-end (entry to completion), one observation per RPC. Quantiles are computed from the raw histogram buckets, not pre-aggregated, so they stay accurate across nodes with uneven traffic.

panels.title: Transaction commit rate by outcome
panels.description: consensa_txn_commits_total is incremented once per txn.Coordinator.Commit call, labeled success or failure -- a rising failure rate usually means real write conflicts (ErrWriteBelowObservedRead) rather than a coordinator bug, since Commit itself has no retry loop.

panels.title: Range splits executed
panels.description: consensa_kv_split_executed_total increments once a live split actually completes (not just when it was recommended -- see consensa_kv_split_recommended for the decision signal). Each split also appears as a vertical annotation across every panel on this dashboard, marked at the moment it executed.
